title: Man. Post. Cap. IX: PLAC — imputatum-est substitution; Apostolic speech ruined
pass_a_gloss: But to storm all obstinacy: put imputatum est in place of introiit, and see how finely the Apostle's speech proceeds—'through one man sin was imputed to the world, and through sin death.' Was death imputed? Imputed through sin? Was sin imputed through Adam? Do not those who dispute me so make the Apostle, as far as in them lies, ridiculous?
pass_b_english: But, that every obstinacy may be stormed, in place of introiit put imputatum est, see how finely the Apostle's speech will proceed: through one man sin was imputed to the world, and through sin death. Was death imputed? Was it imputed through sin? Was sin imputed through Adam? Do they not make the Apostle ridiculous, as far as in them lies, who so dispute against me?
source_text: Sed, ut omnis expugnetur pertinacia, loco introiit pone imputatum est, vide quam belle procedet Apostoli oratio, per unum hominem peccatum imputatum est mundo, & per peccatum mors. Num imputata est mors? num imputata est per peccatum? num peccatum est imputatum per Adamum? Nonne ridiculum, quantum in ipsis est, qui sic contra me disputant, faciunt Apostolum?

lemmas.gloss: in place of introiit put imputatum est

choices.choice: Swap imputatum est for introiit → absurd Apostolic speech
